question: Which country won the 4th Asian Kho-Kho Championship 2023 event in the women's category?
solution:
The correct answer is __**India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **India** emerged victorious in the **4th Asian Kho-Kho Championship 2023**, held in the **women's category**. This victory showcases India’s dominance in traditional sports.
 
• The championship took place in the year **2023**, emphasizing India’s consistent performance in the sport of Kho-Kho.
 
• India has been a pioneer in promoting and excelling in Kho-Kho, a traditional Indian sport that originated in **Maharashtra**.
 
• This victory further solidifies India’s position in the international arena of Kho-Kho, as the sport gains recognition globally. *Hence, statement 1 is correct.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **About Kho-Kho:**

 
 
• **Kho-Kho** is one of the oldest and most popular traditional sports of **India**, believed to have originated in **Maharashtra**.
 
• It is a **team-based tag sport** played between two teams, typically consisting of 12 players each, with 9 players taking the field at a time.
 
• The game is recognized by the **Kho-Kho Federation of India** and is played at national and international levels.
 
 
 
• **About the Asian Kho-Kho Championship:**
 
 
• The **Asian Kho-Kho Championship** is a prestigious event organized to promote Kho-Kho at the international level.
 
• The 4th edition in **2023** witnessed participation from various Asian countries, demonstrating the growing popularity of this traditional sport.
 
• India has consistently performed well in the championship, showcasing its expertise and dominance in the sport.
 
 
 
• **Other Participating Countries:**
 
 
• Countries like **Iran**, **South Korea**, and **Indonesia** also participated, highlighting the increasing international reach of Kho-Kho.
 
• While these nations are developing their skills in Kho-Kho, India remains the leader in terms of performance and strategy.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Historical Significance of Kho-Kho:**

 
 
• Kho-Kho has its roots in **ancient India**, with references found in historical texts like the **Mahabharata**.
 
• The sport emphasizes agility, speed, and teamwork, making it unique among traditional games.
 
 
 
• **India’s Contribution to Kho-Kho:**
 
 
• India has been instrumental in promoting Kho-Kho at the international level through events like the **Asian Championship**.
 
• The **Kho-Kho Federation of India** has been actively working to enhance the sport’s popularity and provide platforms for talented players.
